name: Business Card
summary: Printed business cards in eighteen designs: your name and contact lines, a logo or your initials, a QR code and an NFC tag, on one face or both, raised or flush, in up to three colours.
credits: Feature set after the Vostok Labs Business Card Generator; every design written for Print Factory. QR codes by qrcode-generator (Kazuhiko Arase, MIT). Icons from Tabler (MIT).
